findings.explanation: Order placed 2026-07-17, electronics/premium, within the July Tech Promo window (2026-07-08 to 2026-07-18) which discounts premium electronics commission from 16% to 14%. Settlement charged commission of 67.89 (16% of gross 424.29), but the correct promo commission is 59.40 (14% of 424.29). Shipping (39.90, heavy) was correct. Expected net = 424.29 - 59.40 - 39.90 = 324.99, but observed net = 316.50, a shortfall of 8.49.

Partial refund of 3.59 on gross 17.93 (fashion, not covered by any promo). Per the refund rule, the marketplace_fee on the refund row must return round_half_up(total_fee_on_payment * refund%) = round_half_up(8.58 * (3.59/17.93)) = 1.72. The observed refund row shows fee=0.00, i.e. the commission was never returned to the seller. Expected order net total = 9.35 (payment) - 1.87 (refund) = 7.48; observed = 9.35 - 3.59 = 5.76, a shortfall of 1.72.
